title: Bar Tutni
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shabbat 71a and Keritot 4b, with [Resh Lakish] reporting in his name.

Hyman reports that the Soncino printing of Shabbat 71a reads Tovyani. This accounts for the old Yuchasin’s entry “Rav Tovyani, a student of Resh Lakish,” which Seder HaDorot says it could not locate. Hyman instead proposes the reading of Yuchasin HaShalem: “Bar Tovyani, whose student was Resh Lakish.”

notes.text: The first source unit prints א״ל, but Shabbat 71a explicitly has Resh Lakish reporting Bar Tutni. The old Yuchasin formulation calls Tovyani Resh Lakish’s pupil; Hyman’s final תלמידו ר״ל reverses this: Resh Lakish was his pupil.
